set.body:
Requested by a downstream desktop host (eyes4s Studio), stated generically. Found while building a canvas host on the 56506d2 interaction pieces.

Problem
A host that both draws and picks the same scene must lower it repeatedly: NamedPicking.compile resolves the scene itself, and JavaFxProgram.fromDevice is private, so the host cannot reuse one resolved DeviceScene for drawing, picking and overlays. At about 11,500 marks this costs tens of milliseconds per frame compile.

Scope
Expose the resolved device scene as a public, immutable value and accept it in NamedPicking (e.g. NamedPicking.fromResolved) and the JavaFX program builder (e.g. JavaFxProgram.fromDevice).

Acceptance criteria
1. Resolving once and building both a picking plan and a JavaFX program from the result gives output identical to the current separate paths (JVM and Scala.js for picking).
2. A benchmark records lowering count and time for draw+pick before and after.
3. Additive API.
set.title: [Intaglio] Lower a scene once: public device-scene entry points for picking and JavaFX programs
